856-4321-7272-8347.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least four card types in your graveyard.
You control at least one Food.
856-4321-7272-8347.description:
Activate Reaper of Flight Moonsilver by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food, returning Cauldron Familiar to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Cauldron Familiar and Sela trigger.
Resolve the Sela trigger, creating a token and a Food token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat

4336-5006-6798-8170.description:
Cast Kobolds of Kher Keep by paying {0}.
Flickering Hound triggers, blinking Lurrus.
Resolve the Kobolds of Kher Keep spell. Then, activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Kobolds of Kher Keep, causing you to surveil 1
Repeat.

323-2393-4279--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
323-2393-4279--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Falkenrath Noble, Sifter of Skulls and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Falkenrath Noble trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Sifter of Skulls ability, creating a 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Falkenrath Noble triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

1170-3698-5131-7054--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-3698-5131-7054--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Gravebreaker Lamia.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell. When the artifact enters, Grinding Station triggers, untapping Grinding Station.
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing the artifact.
Repeat.

1563-3899-7296-7824.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

1251-3259-5982.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1251-3259-5982.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Ancient Gold Dragon, triggering Breath of Fury and Ancient Gold Dragon.
Resolve the Ancient Gold Dragon trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

1575-4659-5903.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing an artifact, which is a Food due to Gourmand's Talent.
Nuka-Cola Vending Machine triggers, creating a tapped Treasure token.
Repeat.

140-3527-7433.description:
Activate Spatial Binding by paying life.
Repeat step 1 as desired.
Activate Rowan by tapping it, reducing the cost of all black and/or red spells you cast this turn.
Cast a copy of Exsanguinate, choosing for X to equal the amount of life you've lost this turn, but paying a total of {B}{B} due to Rowan.
Resolve Exsanguinate, causing each opponent to lose X life, and you to gain life equal to the life lost this way.

6553-6798-7424.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Brotherhood Outcast.
When Brotherhood Outcast dies, Changing Loyalty triggers, returning Brotherhood Outcast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Brotherhood Outcast enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Changing Loyalty from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

789-2034-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control a land.
You control another nonland creature.
789-2034-7084.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another nonland creature.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Gutter Grime and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Gutter Grime trigger, creating a creature token.
Repeat.
789-2034-7084.notes: As Gutter Grime will get more and more slime counters, the final token you make will be infinitely large.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

6797-6972-7235.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Stag Beetle.
When Stag Beetle dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the creature tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

1170-1177-2510-5078.description:

Activate Narset by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to look at the top four cards of your library, then reveal Sensei's Divining Top and put it into your hand.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0}
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Narset.
Repeat.

Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{G}{G}{U}.
Activate Lilysplash Mentor by paying {1}{G}{U}, blinking Selvala.
Repeat.

3457-4359-5921-5970.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Seeker of Skybreak.
Activate one of the Seeker of Skybreak tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Seeker of Skybreak token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

1379-1978-5704.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three creatures with power 4 or greater.
1379-1978-5704.description:

Repeat

3054-3416-5670-5933.easyPrerequisites:
You've gained life this turn if Oathsworn Vampire is in your graveyard.
Your life total is at least 2.
3054-3416-5670-5933.description:
Cast Oathsworn Vampire either from your hand or graveyard by paying {1}{B}.
Edgar triggers, creating a 1/1 Vampire creature token.
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Oathsworn Vampire.
When Oathsworn Vampire dies, Popular Egotist triggers, causing target opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Repeat steps 3 through 5 once, sacrificing the Vampire token instead.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Repeat.

1069-2457-4927-5499.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three artifacts.
1069-2457-4927-5499.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0} due to Puresteel Paladin, attaching it to the Insect.
Activate the Insect by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may repeat step 1 as desired.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with six or more charge counters on it

198-4067-5799-6571.description:
Activate Empowered Autogenerator by tapping it, putting a charge counter on it and adding {B} for each charge counter on it.
Cast Brush with Death with buyback by paying {4}{B}{B}{B}.
Shantotto triggers, giving it +7/+0 until end of turn and causing you to draw a card.
Resolve Brush with Death.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Empowered Autogenerator.
Repeat.

325-2428-5636-6282.easyPrerequisites:
Your life total is at least 2.
You have at least one card in hand.
325-2428-5636-6282.description:
Activate Psychic Frog by discarding a card.
Toluz's second ability triggers, exiling the discarded card from your graveyard.
Ketramose triggers, causing you to draw a card and lose 1 life.
Horizon Chimera triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Psychic Frog ability.
Repeat.

1477-1737-3621-4853.description:
Activate Prototype Portal by paying {8} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Su-Chi Cave Guard.
Activate Extruder by sacrificing Su-Chi Cave Guard.
When Su-Chi Cave Guard dies, Su-Chi Cave Guard and Dross Scorpion trigger.
Resolve the Su-Chi Cave Guard trigger, adding eight {C}.
Resolve the Dross Scorpion trigger, untapping Prototype Portal.
Resolve the Extruder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

Activate Cogwork Assembler by paying {7}, creating two token copies of Boommobile.
When the Boommobile tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, adding {8} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Repeat.
152-4365-6252.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may activate a Boommobile to deal infinite damage to any target(s).

2921-3394-6249--5.notablePrerequisites:
Weatherlight Compleated has at least six phyresis counters on it.
The persist creature does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
2921-3394-6249--5.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, it and Weatherlight Compleated trigger.
Resolve the Weatherlight Compleated trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the persist creature's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters the battlefield, Olivia triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature and causing you to discard a card.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

277-1170-1770-3389-5954.description:
Cast Flickering Ward by paying {W}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When Overlord of the Hauntwoods enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens.
When the Everywhere land tokens enter the battlefield, Tiller Engine triggers, untapping them.
Resolve the Flickering Ward spell.
Activate the two Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {W}{W}.
Activate Flickering Ward by paying {W}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

372-673-5913.notablePrerequisites:
You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Planar Incision exiled by Abdel Adrian.
Pinnacle Monk exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-673-5913.description:
Cast Planar Incision by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Pinnacle Monk and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Pinnacle Monk trigger.
Resolve the Pinnacle Monk trigger, returning Planar Incision from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Planar Incision.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Pinnacle Monk and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

3946-4935-5448.description:
Play Glacial Chasm either from your hand or from your graveyard.
When Glacial Chasm enters the battlefield, its second ability triggers, causing you to sacrifice another land you control.
Play any land from your graveyard.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Glacial Chasm's cumulative upkeep ability triggers, allowing you to choose not to pay the cost and sacrifice it instead.
Repeat.

Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Su-Chi Cave Guard, adding {C}{C}.
When Su-Chi Cave Guard dies, it triggers, adding eight {C}.
Activate Transplant Theorist by paying {2}, putting Su-Chi Cave Guard on the bottom of your library from your graveyard.
Activate Grenzo by paying {2}, putting Su-Chi Cave Guard into your graveyard from the bottom of your library, and then putting it onto the battlefield.
Repeat.

1261-3918.notablePrerequisites: Trazyn the Infinite does not have summoning sickness.
1261-3918.description:
Activate Trazyn the Infinite using Time Vault's activated ability by tapping it, gaining an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
Repeat.

618-864-4377.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying {4}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn.
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Eternal Witness with haste.
The token copy of Eternal Witness enters the battlefield, returning Walk the Aeons from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

364-1987-2493.notablePrerequisites: You control an artifact or land that enters the battlefield untapped and can produce {U}.
364-1987-2493.description:
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Archaeomancer and your untapped source, blinking them both.
When Archaeomancer enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to your hand.
Tap your untapped blue source for {U}.
Repeat.
